h1: The 7 Best Bookshelf Nightstands of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven bookshelf nightstands from simple open shelves to tall units with drawers, LED and charging, compared by size and capacity.
summary: The Fixwal 47 inch tower is the best bookshelf nightstand: four fabric drawers, two open shelves, five charging ports including USB-C and RGB LED, for $50 to $100. The Furnulem 45.3 inch adds four open tiers and an anti-tip device, and the 38 inch Furnulem is the budget tower. The IOTXY is the statement piece.
intro: A bookshelf nightstand sounds like a clever space-saver, until you notice that the tall ones stand on a base only 12 to 20 inches deep and lean forward when you load the top. The footprint is small, but stability and what you plan to store matter more than the number of shelves in the product photo. A tower that tips is worse than a table with no shelves at all.

We reviewed seven models on paper, from open shelves under $25 to a 71 inch statement piece, and ranked them on storage layout, stated capacity, tip safety, charging features and footprint, using listings and owner reports. Heights run from 22.8 to 70.87 inches, which is a range of bedside furniture rather than one product category.

products.name: Fixwal 47" Tall Nightstand, 4 Drawers + Bookshelf + LED + Charging
products.verdict: The tallest, best-equipped tower, with USB-C and four drawers.
products.description:
The Fixwal stands 47.2 inches tall on an 11.8 by 15.7 inch footprint, with four PU-finished fabric drawers and two open shelves. It has RGB LED with music sync, app and remote control, and charging through two AC, two USB and one USB-C port. It sells for $50 to $100. A USB-C port is the useful part, since phones and tablets increasingly charge that way.

It ranks first because it is the only one with USB-C and a premium PU-finished drawer face. Against the Furnulem 45.3 inch below it, you get more drawers but less open shelf space. The five-foot cord reaches a wall outlet from the far side of a bed.

Buy it if you want a tall tower with plenty of charging. The caveat is that tall furniture needs wall anchoring and only two shelves are open. Skip it if you want mostly open shelf space.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting the most charging and drawers in one tower.
products.skipIf: You want mostly open shelf space.

products.name: Furnulem 45.3" Tall Nightstand, 3 Drawers + 4-Tier Bookshelf + LED + Charging
products.verdict: Four open tiers, three drawers and a built-in anti-tip device.
products.description:
The Furnulem 45.3 inch measures 14.96 by 11.81 inches at the base, with four open shelf tiers and three drawers on a metal frame with wood shelves. It has 7-color LED with app or button control, two AC and two USB ports, two S-hooks and an anti-tip device. It sells for $50 to $100. An anti-tip device anchors the frame to the wall, which matters on a tower this narrow.

It ranks second because it gives up the USB-C port and one drawer relative to the Fixwal. In return you get twice the open shelving and a stated anti-tip device, in the same price range. Against the 38 inch Furnulem, it adds height and shelf tiers.

Choose it if you want maximum open shelf space for books. The caveat is fewer drawers for hidden clutter. Skip it if you prefer closed storage.
products.idealFor: Readers who want books on display and drawers below.

products.name: Furnulem 38" Tall Nightstand, 4 Drawers + Bookshelf + LED + Charging
products.verdict: Four drawers, LED and charging at a lower price.
products.description:
The 38 inch Furnulem is 14.96 by 11.8 inches at the base, with four fabric drawers and two wood shelf tiers on a metal frame. It has a 6-color RGB LED, two AC and two USB ports, and a 6.5 foot cord. It sells for $25 to $50. A long cord matters at a bedside, where outlets sit behind the bed or across the room.

It ranks third because the lower height cuts storage versus the 45.3 inch version, but it undercuts it by a price tier. The 6.5 foot cord is also the longest here. Against the Fixwal, it gives up USB-C and about 9 inches of height for a lower price.

Buy it if you want drawers, LED and charging on a budget. The caveat is that no anti-tip hardware is listed, so anchor it yourself. Skip it if you want maximum shelf height.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers wanting drawers and charging.

products.name: IOTXY 71" Walnut Bedside Table + Bookshelf
products.verdict: A 71 inch L-shape walnut bookshelf with 65 lb capacity.
products.description:
The IOTXY is 70.87 inches tall on a 19.69 by 15.75 inch footprint, built from wood-grain MDF with solid wood legs. It has four open shelves, two metal-rail drawers and two side hooks in an L-shape design. Capacity is 50 lb per shelf and 65 lb in total. It sells for $100 to $200. Metal rails carry a drawer load more smoothly than fabric.

It ranks fourth because it lacks the charging and LED of the Fixwal and Furnulem models, though it has the most shelving. Stated capacity is its strength: few tall units give a per-shelf figure. Against the Simple Trending, it costs far more for much more storage.

Choose it as a design-forward statement piece. The caveat is its large footprint beside a bed. Skip it if you need built-in charging.
products.idealFor: People wanting a statement bookshelf by the bed.

products.name: Simple Trending 3-Tier Side Table, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: A metal-frame three-tier shelf with 50 lb capacity.
products.description:
The Simple Trending is 13.4 by 11.8 inches at the base and 25.5 inches tall, built from wood and thick metal tubing with three open shelves. Total capacity is 50 lb, and adjustable foot pads level it. It sells for under $25. Metal tubing resists wobble better than thin particleboard uprights, which suits a nightstand that gets bumped.

It ranks fifth because it is just a shelf, with no drawers or charging. It carries more weight than the Furinno and stays in the lowest price tier. Against the Huuger pair, it has an open design and no mesh shelf or drawer.

Buy it for a simple, sturdy nightstand. The caveat is open storage only, so clutter stays visible. Skip it if you want hidden storage.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting a sturdy, simple open-shelf nightstand.

products.name: Furinno JUST 3-Tier Open Shelf Nightstand, French Oak
products.verdict: A tool-less 6.2 lb shelf in FSC-certified recycled wood.
products.description:
The Furinno JUST is 13.4 by 11.5 inches at the base and 22.8 inches tall, made of FSC-certified engineered wood with 95 to 100 percent recycled content. It has three open shelves with 45 lb total capacity, weighs 6.2 lbs and has rounded safety corners. One person assembles it without tools. It sells for under $25. At 6.2 lbs, it is easy to move for floor cleaning.

It ranks sixth because capacity is lower than the Simple Trending, though it is lighter and easier to build. Rounded corners make it kinder around kids. Against the Simple Trending, it trades 5 lb of capacity for lower weight and a recycled-content story.

Choose it for a simple, eco-minded shelf. The caveat is limited capacity. Skip it if you store heavy items.
products.idealFor: Buyers wanting a simple eco-friendly shelf.

products.name: Huuger Nightstand Set of 2, Fabric Drawer + Mesh Shelf
products.verdict: Two matching metal-frame nightstands for both sides of the bed.
products.description:
The Huuger set includes two nightstands, each 15.75 by 11.8 inches at the base and 23.8 inches tall. Each has one fabric drawer, one open mesh shelf and a desktop surface on a metal frame with adjustable feet. The set sells for $25 to $50. Adjustable feet level each table on uneven floors, and a matching pair looks intentional.

It ranks last because each unit holds less than a tower, but it is the only pair here. The price covers both tables, so each costs about half. Against the Fixwal, it loses charging and height but is easier to move.

Buy it to furnish both sides of the bed. The caveat is limited storage per unit. Skip it if you need lots of storage in one unit.
products.idealFor: Couples furnishing both sides of the bed.
products.skipIf: You need lots of storage in one unit.

whatMatters.detail: Tall units stand 38 to 71 inches on a base of only 12 to 20 inches. A narrow base on a tall unit is less stable. Measure your bedside gap against the listed width and depth, and note that the IOTXY needs the most floor. Include space for the drawer pull, and check the door or window swing near the bed.

A tall nightstand can tip if the top shelf is overloaded. An anti-tip device anchors it to the wall. The Furnulem 45.3 inch lists one, so check the others and add your own strap if it is missing. A tower with heavy books on top is the one that falls, so keep the top light and anchor into a wall stud.

Capacity is listed per shelf or in total, and they are not the same. The IOTXY lists 50 lb per shelf and 65 lb total. The Simple Trending lists 50 lb total. Compare the same measure across listings, and put heavy items on the lowest shelves. Do not stack more than the figure, which assumes even loading.

Drawers hide clutter and open shelves display books. Pick the ratio that suits you. Count each in the product title: the Fixwal has four drawers and two shelves, the Furnulem 45.3 inch three drawers and four tiers. A mostly open tower collects dust, so favor drawers if you dislike dusting.

AC and USB ports remove the power strip. USB-C is rare and appears on the Fixwal. Check the port list and the cord length. The 38 inch Furnulem has a 6.5 foot cord and the Fixwal five feet, which decides whether the tower reaches the outlet behind the bed. Check where your wall outlet sits first.

howToChoose.intro: Match shelf and drawer count to what you keep by the bed.

faq.q: Will a tall nightstand tip over?
faq.a: It can if overloaded at the top. The Furnulem 45.3 inch lists an anti-tip device, so anchor the others to the wall, especially the Fixwal and IOTXY, which stand tallest and tip with the least push. A wall strap costs little and can prevent an injury.

They compare shelf counts and ignore capacity. Check whether the limit is per shelf or total, as the IOTXY lists 50 lb per shelf and 65 lb total. A simple shelf like the Simple Trending lists only a combined figure, so load it lightly.

faq.q: Is the Fixwal worth it over the Furnulem 38?
faq.a: If you want USB-C, extra height and music-sync LED, yes. The 38 inch Furnulem costs less and still gives four drawers. The Fixwal's extra height adds the open shelves, and music-sync LED is a bonus rather than a need.

The Furinno models assemble without tools by one person. Others have more parts, so allow extra time, and expect the IOTXY and tall Furnulem to want a helper. Tighten bolts again after a week, since towers loosen with use.

faq.q: How do I clean fabric drawers?
faq.a: Wipe fabric drawers with a damp cloth. Check the manual before using cleaners, and vacuum dust from open shelves on the Furnulem towers. Dry fabric drawers fully before closing them.

faq.q: Can I use two Furnulem units as a pair?
faq.a: You can, but the 38 inch and 45.3 inch have different heights. Buy two of the same model for a match, or choose the Huuger set, which sells as a matching pair. A mismatch in height looks odd beside a bed.

finalTake: Buy the Fixwal for the most charging and drawers in one tower, and the Furnulem 45.3 inch for open shelves and a built-in anti-tip device. The 38 inch Furnulem suits a budget, the IOTXY a design-led room, and the Simple Trending or Furinno a plain shelf. Anchor any tall unit to the wall before loading the top.
